notes.title: QANGA Update - Patch Notes v0.0.17
notes.notes: [p]Hey Cyborgs![/p][p]A brand new QANGA update is here! 🎉[/p][p]This version brings a lot of new content: a new city, a brand new starting point for Cyborgs, two new ships, police units already deployed in the game, and more than 60 new construction pieces. Among other things.[/p][p]We decided to split this update into two phases. The new police system, which was originally planned to be part of this release, will arrive a bit later so we can fine-tune it to meet our expectations. In the meantime, you can already encounter police units in the world and see them in action.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What's New[/h2][p][/p][h3]Awakening Center[/h3][p]A brand new building now stands near the Relay Tower: the [b]Awakening Center[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/664b2fd9116133cd49bbf4bd1297c47db15d7cf2.png"][/img][/p][p]This is where new Cyborgs will begin their journey. The tutorial mission is not available yet but is already well advanced. It will be added in a future update and will allow you to:[/p][list][*][p]Discover your new body and your first upgrade modules[/p][/*][*][p]Activate your drone and learn how to use it[/p][/*][*][p]Meet [b]Tona[/b], one of the key characters in the story[/p][/*][/list][p]This setup lays the groundwork for a much more narrative and immersive introduction.[/p][p]But for now, you can already visit the building that will host this new introduction.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9d7ff7a9f0220313a91f47a70e856b7ca5ed2a22.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/eddec0fb0d56da576af3bd218cbf2dac40ec470c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/5878ae37f37514494928a60dd30f3d26585a4808.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/16ed1aa72d708ab0aa77f01f6734b57c73efa60e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/bb213becb5deecf6cd9947cbd07fa1ef25a85fdf.png"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Djibouti City[/h3][p]Not far from this same Relay Tower, a new city has just emerged. Djibouti City will be the true starting point of the adventure for new Cyborgs.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f308fb6c8befad9264023cd76701ac612a77837f.png"][/img][/p][p]We are still working on the overall atmosphere, but our goal is to make it a village protected from the Sanglines by the police, a safe place where players can rest, trade, and prepare before heading out on missions, with everything you would expect from such a place: shops, medical center, armory, delivery points, and more.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9c8417bd927540172ced868b8f7ec21820351f78.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/425cf985ef40a6cbf50242fa7608fc7674fb71c3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/6520e6cf2391e02cacfe5ee66276c4d3177f6af7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1638cdbc5de43d9488284de3ba9cdee4a555baa2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/0920968c8e2f7f739bb1edac6ec8548c6ca4fc91.png"][/img][/carousel][p]With the mission system currently in development, Djibouti City will gradually become the heart of progression and new quests. This new system will significantly transform the overall experience in the coming months.[/p][p]How about a quick guided tour?[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="-aZEhvdCu0A;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]New Ships and Vehicles[/h3][p]Two new ships are arriving:[/p][list][*][p][b]Lavrik[/b], with its police variant[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b7001aef9bdda6bd7169411722edb115e963baf6.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Orizaune[/b], a lighter and more agile model[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/cd9579e8d2180255c3a8662aa704ec71ee4eecec.png"][/img][/p][p]On the ground side, the [b]Melrose[/b] car also gets its police variant.[/p][p][/p][h3]First Deployed Police Units[/h3][p]Even though the full police system is not active yet, you can already encounter and interact with the new units:[/p][list][*][p]Police Cyborgs[/p][/*][*][p]Autonomous units[/p][/*][*][p]Drones[/p][/*][*][p]Patrol ships[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/d614b401812338688f485c572489a42c8d0014c5.png"][/img][/p][p]You can even get inside police vehicles, turn on the lights and blast the sirens! We will share more details about the full police system (and wanted levels) in an upcoming post.[/p][p][/p][h3]Construction - New IronDee Collection[/h3][p]A huge addition for construction with more than 60 new pieces![/p][p]A brand new collection, IronDee, is now available alongside the existing ICLabs collection. Perfect for creating even more unique and stylish bases.[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b9135ac5a37df447ea33be5930f3e3dc4383606f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9a0fa825516306266c7f903527eb208106e0cde1.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/2e533fa58c3e7cb21312b82bd983954e9556263b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/fe761e24ac525f7642bd669a81e7ba9fdacd76d1.png"][/img][/carousel][p]We also took the opportunity to add the "Zoop" mode, a system that lets you place several elements in a row with a single action, perfect for building a wall or aligning several floors quickly. You can select the mode with the default "G" key, with three options:[/p][list][*][p]Single (one piece placed)[/p][/*][*][p]H Zoop (horizontal Zoop)[/p][/*][*][p]V Zoop (vertical Zoop)[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="vN4SmY2VhDg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]Radios[/h3][p]Fixed radios have been placed in the world, for now in Finistère and Djibouti City. elements in a single click.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Snap Only and Free Only Modes Added[/b]: gives you more precise control over element placement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Building Pieces[/b]: several new base, notes.title: QANGA UPDATE "Emerging plagues" - Patch Notes v0.0.15
notes.notes:
[b]Qanga is evolving once again.[/b]

This update introduces new threats with the arrival of fresh Sangline variants, alongside new opportunities for the most daring Cyborgs. From enhanced enemies to technical optimizations and economic features, every expedition is now more strategic than ever.

Thank you for your continued feedback — it helps us refine the experience. Here’s what’s coming in this new version:

[h2]🚀 NEW FEATURES 🚀[/h2]

[h3]New Sanglines Incoming[/h3]
Three new Sangline types have emerged across the surface. The [b]Gas Sac[/b], previously present in limited areas for testing, is now fully integrated with finalized behaviors, sound effects, and deadly interactions. It is joined by two additional variants, bringing new tactical threats to your expeditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f78a26a79c4b6da362c354880a4c85105d64438e.jpg[/img]

[b]Main characteristics:[/b]

[b]Gas Sac[/b]
[list]
[*]Explodes when near the player.
[*]Releases a toxic cloud on death.
[*]Slow but unpredictable.
[*]Dangerous in groups or confined spaces.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/17b65d42735b99136d6186ae7cf8d967b1df2967.png[/img]

[b]Flyer[/b]
[list]
[*]Flies and attacks in diving motions.
[*]Hard to hit, especially in open areas.
[*]Moves erratically to dodge shots.
[*]Fragile but fast.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/14809a6284a3be7fd60f459d6b18726d1a5bf323.png[/img]

[b]Sand Digger[/b]
[list]
[*]Burrows underground and emerges to attack.
[*]Detectable through ground vibrations or dust eruptions.
[*]Perfect for ambush tactics.
[*]Tough, with a surface-based area attack.
[*]It can protect itself with its large front limbs.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/250bdb5fa134d72600185ebc74295a69c8840214.png[/img]

[h3]New Structure: The Refinery[/h3]

A refinery is now available in select zones. It allows Cyborgs to deposit harvested materials and sell them with a processing bonus. This new interaction point becomes a strategic stop to maximize profits from exploration and loot.

[previewyoutube=kb3OjUbhZ0s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New locations[/h3]

Two major new areas are now accessible in Qanga: a ruined city overgrown with vegetation and an abandoned fortified metropolis. These environments have been added on an experimental basis, primarily to perform performance tests and offer a first glimpse of the post-disaster atmosphere we aim to develop.

You’ll find them near Toronto and Moscow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/d5e5ed5e7c751ca4713ee26aaf3c0693c85e3cc0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/61dbe1335b5e528a9a0766c1a00e4045ece19407.jpg[/img]

We want to be fully transparent: these zones currently rely on raw asset versions, which will be thoroughly reworked by our team in the coming months to align with the game’s artistic direction.

notes.title: QANGA UPDATE - Patch Notes v0.0.13a
notes.notes:
We’re excited to bring you the latest update for Qanga, packed with new features, improvements, and bug fixes to enhance your experience. Read on to discover the latest changes that will make your journey even more immersive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]🚀 NEW FEATURES 🚀[/h2]

[h3]Pathfinding[/h3]

The basic pathfinding system of Unreal Engine was not suitable for Qanga for several reasons. First, it doesn't allow for rotations in all directions, making it unusable in a spherical world like a planet. 

Additionally, it is limited to paths on the ground, whereas we needed three types of pathfinding: on the ground, on specific surfaces for the Sanglines, and in the air for flying AI. Therefore, we developed a custom pathfinding system, fully tailored in-house, specifically designed to meet our needs. To date, this system is in alpha and is not yet final.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/2b82ebb7fb5addf69197b51710fce435e0d8f9b0.png[/img]
This system, fully multithreaded, generates a grid in real time in the form of an octree within a uniform cube and allows direct sampling of a planet's surface. This enables us to create any location on the planet on demand. Moreover, the system allows the generation of high-resolution grids for specific areas of the universe, providing increased precision where needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1f450cfe4ede81739761e3f8d02937839b982763.png[/img]
However, there are still many improvements to be made, such as a better distance field system, surface and ground angle management, a multi-level hierarchical grid to cover large areas, support for EQS searches in the grid, pathfinding options adapted to agent size, zone tagging with specific definitions, jump zone detection, real-time updating of movable zones, collision management for multiple paths, non-uniform octree grids, and deferred path calculations. Many optimizations are also coming.

[previewyoutube=gJIA5HYF7QQ;full][/previewyoutube]
The entire system works fully multithreaded, ensuring smooth handling of complex calculations in parallel, and it has been designed without using any external libraries, giving us full control over the tool's customization.

Here's an example of two NPCs walking: 

[previewyoutube=jHzvM2x2ZGw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]HOTAS Support[/h3]

HOTAS support has been added in this update. Although the feature is still in the testing phase, it is fully functional. We’ve integrated a raw input plugin from the engine, allowing for extensive control customization, including up to 24 custom axis. Players can adjust scaling, remapping zones, and deadzones for full analog control via the advanced settings for each axis.

We’ve also ensured that support for standard gamepads is maintained, with compatibility for gamepad analog sticks.

However, due to the variety of controller types, we rely on your feedback to help us refine this feature and ensure it works optimally across a wide range of devices.

[h3]Vehicle Customization[/h3]

The vehicle customization window has been improved. You will also have more color options available (28 + 1 default now).

[previewyoutube=VCk5YvBRaLk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New locations[/h3]

ICLabs has opened a new lunar base. As usual, this location offers all the comfort needed for a well-deserved break. You will find private cabins for your stay, as well as all the amenities to relax. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f9ae85f998a0baeb4b460434194dff3d23d0c67f.jpg[/img]
If you need supplies, the armory and medical service are available. And for those looking to unwind, our bar welcomes you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1e641a0e0e9b0411c72b83a12617b99bb59f1fe8.jpg[/img]
Access the base using the command: /tp moona1.

In parallel, new opportunities are available in space. Mineable asteroids have been added near the ICLISPACE station and are now visible on the Starmap.


[h3]Statistics[/h3]

A new statistics system has been added for characters, allowing players to view counters based on their explorations, including kills, distances traveled, and exploration completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/99d80e157be9e047a520ff85474aed5061d6cbae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]🛠 UI AND CONTROLS IMPROVEMENTS 🛠[/h2]

[list]
[*]Multiple fixes to the input system and UI
[*]Analog inputs support for joysticks and gamepad configuration
[*]Fixed view rotation in the vehicle editor
[*]Improved icons on the star map for testing: to simplify, when looking at the star map, only essential elements like vendors are visible by default. To see other things like contracts, you need to scan, and the icon will appear. To avoid a flood of icons, they have been split between those visible by default and those requiring scanning.
[*]General improvement of English localization.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

[h2]🔧 BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS 🔧[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fixed some issues with the item system to avoid overload on save
[*]Multiple fixes and improvements to the contract system for better functionality at long distances
[*]Optimized collisions for the Single Storm. The problem still persists on certain objects and will be resolved shortly.
[*]Fixed the lighting of the passenger headlight
[*]Fixed buttons on the Single Storm
[*]Multiple adjustments and improvements to the StarMap
[*]Increased docking speed for Warp
[*]Corrected the scanner zone size
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we work to make Qanga even better. Stay tuned for future updates, and keep exploring the vast universe we've created. We look forward to seeing you in-game and on [url=https://discord.gg/qanga]our Discord server[/url]!

Using a new shadow baking technique, each light source generates a pre-calculated specific texture that projects detailed shadows, even over long distances. This optimization also eliminates the white haze that was previously visible on objects illuminated by distant lights.

[list]

[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/37ddb57a759344b0eff572bac7a2ddc50e138d3b.png[/img]

[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]
[list]
    [*][b]Lumen Distance Origin:[/b] Lumen currently does not support long distances, creating global illumination artifacts far from the world origin. This issue will be fixed in future Unreal Engine updates.[/*]
    [*][b]Texture Artifact Triangle:[/b] Some materials may display triangular reflection artifacts at great distances. This issue will be resolved in future updates.[/*]
    [*][b]Contract Failures:[/b] Some contracts fail immediately upon acceptance. This issue is under investigation.[/*]
    [*][b]Vehicle Owner Replication:[/b] Rarely, the position of your vehicle is not correctly replicated to friends. We are investigating this issue.[/*]
    [*][b]VO-IP Delay:[/b] Audio packets may experience delays. This issue is under investigation.[/*]
    [*][b]BackPack Inconsistency:[/b] The current logic is based on slots. We plan to rework the inventory system to base it on weight.[/*]
[/list]


We still have many surprises in store, but we prefer to let you discover them yourself. Your feedback is crucial, so please share your impressions on our Steam community or here on Discord.
We invite you to join the discord, the community is here to help you understand the game.

See you soon in the world of QANGA!


[b]The QANGA Team[/b]

notes.title: QANGA DEMO Update: Enhancements and Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Major QANGA Update - Improvements Based on Your Feedback[/h2]

[b]We're excited to announce that a significant update, based on your valuable feedback! After carefully reviewing your comments and watching gameplay videos on YouTube, we've crafted enhancements to enrich your gaming experience.[/b]

[b]New Features and Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Immediate Access to Gameplay: The introduction sequence has been removed for a direct immersion into the world of QANGA.
[*]Gender Choice at Startup: Players can choose their gender right from the start and embark on their adventure as a cyborg.
[*]Access to Flying Vehicles from the Beginning: Quick access to flying vehicles in the starting area for an enhanced traversal experience.
[/list]

[b]Tutorial and Gameplay:[/b]
Improved Tutorial: Enhanced understanding of game mechanics with the introduction of:
[list]
[*]Item Recycling: Convert items into "matter" energy.
[*]Third-Person Drone Camera: Visible and destructible by other players.
[*]Phases: Allocate skill points to weapons and cyborg modules.
[*]Cyborg Modules: For example, jetpack improvement for fast flying.
[*]Discovery Points: Enhanced exploration with discovery terminals.
[/list]

[b]User Interface and Navigation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removal of On-Screen Trackers: Trackers are now integrated into the StarMap for a cleaner interface.
[*]Clarity of On-Screen Trackers: Unique color system for easy identification of different elements (ReselleMachine, Matter distributor, etc.).
[/list]

[b]Graphical Optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*]Visual Improvements: Optimizations for PoleLights, Volumetric Clouds, and Foliage Mesh for better graphical performance.
[*]PostProcess Enhancement: More realistic lens flare effects.
[/list]

[b]Global Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Visibility of Phases on Objects: Correction of phase visibility.
[*]Level Loading: Resolution of level streaming issues.
[*]Elevator Button Operation: Fix for buttons getting stuck.
[*]Discovery Terminal XP Adjustments: Tweaks for better balance.
[*]Vehicle Input Feedback: Improved feedback for vehicle controls.
[/list]

In light of these changes, we hope you will also perceive the true sandbox nature of the game. Our vision for QANGA has always been to provide a vast, open-ended experience where creativity and exploration are paramount. 

Stay connected for upcoming updates, and please feel free to keep sharing your experiences and suggestions.

[url=https://discord.gg/qanga]Server Discord[/url] 

Thank you for being part of this exciting adventure.
